Independent native wavefunction grids

Psi4 1.9.1 RHF/cc-pVTZ water, pure/cartesian, PK SCF energy and density thresholds 1e-10. Native BasisSet.compute_phi values combined with Ca (MO 0/4/5) and Da+Db were saved in float64 at cube coordinates. Fresh FCHK/Molden exports accompany each grid. Coordinates are Bohr.

ORCA 6.1.1 core MO 0 binary grid uses the original water GBW corresponding to ../wavefunction_exchange/orca_f, native orca_plot format 5, 17 points per axis over [-4,4] Bohr. Header: five int32 values, six float32 bounds in Angstrom, then float32 values with x varying fastest. Exact plot-input coordinates avoid header rounding.

Unchanged absolute/relative L2 gates 2e-5. Original rounded cube fixtures and raw limitations are retained separately. Generated numerical data contains no program implementation.
